title: Weinbrenner deathbed claim of ET bodies in Utah
summary: UAPGerb tells of Weinbrenner deathbed claim of ET bodies in Utah, about unspecified at Dugway Proving Ground, Utah, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: there's a lot of research proposed by like Grant Cameron and um Anthony Brigalia and so forth about uh wine Brener on his deathbed saying that they house uh dead extraterrestrials at a facility out in Utah which of course is Dougway proving grounds.

plain: A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb (UAP is the government's newer term for UFOs) told podcast host Jesse Michels about a claim studied by fellow researchers Grant Cameron and Anthony Bragalia. According to that claim, a man named Weinbrenner said on his deathbed that dead extraterrestrials were kept at a facility in Utah, which UAPGerb says is Dugway Proving Ground, a military testing site there. If true, it would mean alien bodies are being held on a US military base.
